notes: No public source gives a modern on-demand VM interruption rate (plan §7.13); this profile is derived, using only sources whose recoverability is known. Host reboots: Ford's unplanned reboots (all events; Table 1 cell range as low/high) x (1 - f_LM), f_LM in {0.5, 0.25, 0} (Narya/AFPD: live migration and prediction hide a large share). Software: Ford's >=15-min node restarts (short automatic restarts are left to planned downtime and exec #10). Host loss (non-disk faults that lose the host): 0 - no source says which host faults lose local data (Vishwanath's non-disk repairs and LANL were excluded for this reason); a known optimistic gap. Pause: Azure's 30 s at most once per 18 months, pessimistic end only. Disk: disk/pooled. Durations: Ford unplanned-reboot CDF (hw_reboot), Ford node-restart CDF >=15 min (sw). The pessimistic end is clipped to the AWS instance SLA allowance if it exceeds it. Replace with exec #10 measurements as @v2.
